# Karughor

> Karughor is a Bangladesh-based e-commerce platform selling authentic handcrafted products made by skilled Bangladeshi artisans. All products are handmade and delivered with Cash on Delivery (COD) across Bangladesh.

## About

Karughor (কারুঘর) means "house of crafts" in Bengali. We connect Bangladeshi artisans with customers who appreciate authentic handcrafted products.

## Products

- Jute Rugs — handwoven natural jute rugs
- Nakshi Kantha — traditional hand-stitched embroidered quilts, a 300+ year old Bangladeshi art form
- Ladies Bags & Purses — handcrafted jute and fabric bags
- Shotoronji — traditional Bangladeshi hand-woven floor mats
- Three-Piece Sets — traditional Bangladeshi clothing (Batik, Block Print, Jomjom, Party Wear)
- Bed Sheets — pure cotton and hand-embroidered bed sheets
- Wall Art — handcrafted wall art pieces
- Dining Placemats — natural jute and cotton placemats
- Planter Baskets — natural jute and woven plant baskets
- Laundry Baskets — eco-friendly woven storage baskets

## Ordering & Delivery

- Payment: Cash on Delivery only — customers pay when product arrives
- Inside Dhaka delivery: ৳70, 1–3 business days
- Outside Dhaka delivery: ৳120, 3–5 business days
- Orders confirmed via phone call before dispatch
- Order cancellation allowed within 60 minutes of placing
